items: After we accidentally closed a subpoena thread last spring as resolved, I want the agent to ask me before update_ticket_state pushes any tickets.state of open Legal ticket to closed once tickets.age_hours has reached 6.
For tickets.priority of 3 high in the Legal group, do not invoke move_ticket_to_group to Account Management or anywhere else without my explicit confirmation.
Calling delete_ticket on anything sitting in Legal is off limits without me; an internal note is fine.
I pre-clear the agent to update_ticket_state to pending reminder on Legal tickets up to tickets.age_hours of 72; that is exactly how counsel parks items waiting on outside response.

Routing between Legal and Account Management via move_ticket_to_group is fine without confirmation; reassign_ticket_owner among leah.legal@example.com and tom.legal@example.com on any tickets.state of open ticket is also pre-cleared.
tickets.priority of 1 low items can be moved in place freely; only flag me before delete_ticket fires.
